items.title: Deadlines, acrimony and a record as Man City back Maresca for Fernandez deal
items.summary: The summer's longest-running transfer saga ends with Manchester City paying a joint-British record fee to bring in midfielder Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea.

items.title: Balogun's Everton deal collapses after he walks away
items.summary: Everton's pursuit of Folarin Balogun from Monaco collapses after Balogun decides against move.

items.title: Palace sign Chilwell and Timber after deadline
items.summary: Crystal Palace have signed internationals Ben Chilwell and Quinten Timber on permanent deals

items.title: Fernandez joins Man City for joint-British record £125m
items.summary: Manchester City pay a joint-British transfer record fee of £125m for Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez.

items.title: Camara's £47.1m move from Monaco to Chelsea collapses
items.summary: Lamine Camara is staying at Monaco after the Senegal midfielder's £47.1m move to Chelsea collapses.

items.title: Ndiaye's journey from non-league football to £65m Man City move
items.summary: Manchester City sign winger Iliman Ndiaye from Everton in a deal worth up to £65m.

items.title: Brughmans joins Liverpool in deal worth up to £30m
items.summary: Liverpool have secured the signing of teenage goalkeeper Lucca Brughmans for the start of the 2027-28 season.

items.title: Tottenham sign Chelsea pair Mudryk and Tosin
items.summary: Tottenham sign Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk on loan until the end of the season and complete a permanent move for Tosin Adarabioyo.

items.title: Fofana seals £30m move to Sunderland
items.summary: Sunderland have beaten Crystal Palace to the signing of Malick Fofana from Lyon.

items.title: Ipswich sign Burnley forward Flemming for £20m
items.summary: Ipswich sign Burnley forward Zian Flemming on a four-year deal for a reported £20m.

items.title: Sunderland sign Spurs defender Danso on loan
items.summary: Sunderland have signed Austria defender Kevin Danso from Tottenham on a loan deal until the end of the season.

items.title: Newcastle sign Fernandez-Pardo from Lille for £51m
items.summary: Newcastle United sign Belgium forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo from Lille for an initial £51.4m.

items.title: Hull sign six players including £22m Iroegbunam from Everton
items.summary: Hull City sign six players on transfer deadline day including midfielder Tim Iroegbunam from Everton and forward Robinio Vaz from Roma.

items.title: Liverpool tried to sign Gusto - Wednesday's gossip
items.summary: Football gossip: Liverpool made a late move for Chelsea defender Malo Gusto and Manchester United defenders on "trial" this season

items.title: Angel becomes Fulham's third Real Madrid signing of summer
items.summary: Manuel Angel has become the third player to join Fulham from Real Madrid this summer

items.title: Aston Villa sign Mbaye and Harwood-Bellis
items.summary: Aston Villa complete the signings of Senegal winger Ibrahim Mbaye from Paris St-Germain and English centre-back Taylor Harwood-Bellis from Southampton.

items.title: Valencia sign Liverpool's Elliott on loan
items.summary: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott joins Valencia on a season-long loan

items.title: Arsenal's Nwaneri joins Dortmund on loan
items.summary: German club Borussia Dortmund signs Ethan Nwaneri on a season-long loan from Arsenal.

items.title: Brighton sign midfielder Chema Andres from Stuttgart
items.summary: Brighton secure deadline day deal to sign former Real Madrid midfielder Chema Andres from Stuttgart for £15.5m

items.title: Ahanor announced by two clubs in one day after Chelsea workaround
items.summary: Chelsea announce teenage defender Honest Ahanor will join the club in 2027 after the Atalanta player has completed a loan at Crystal Palace.

items.title: Juventus sign Woltemade and Sarr on loan
items.summary: Juventus have announced the arrival of Newcastle forward Nick Woltemade and Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Pape Matar Sarr on season-long loan deals.

items.title: Man Utd fail in attempt to sign Ait-Nouri from Man City
items.summary: Manchester United approached Manchester City in the final hours of the transfer window in an attempt to sign Algeria defender Rayan Ait-Nouri on loan

items.title: Chelsea goalkeeper Sanchez joins Como on loan
items.summary: Chelsea goalkeeper Robert Sanchez joins Como on a season-long loan after losing his starting spot to new arrival Emi Martinez.

items.title: Arteta joins elite 250 club - but where does he rank?
items.summary: Arsenal's fans are singing about winning the league again under Mikel Arteta. Monday's 1-0 win at Aston Villa demonstrated the strengths they have developed under their long-serving manager.
